stem: If I ______ more free time, I would learn another foreign language.
explanation: 主句用 would learn，说明是与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，if 从句用一般过去时 had；从句中不能用 would have。

stem: If he had listened to the doctor, he ______ so ill now.
explanation: 从句 had listened 指过去，主句有时间状语 now，指现在，属于混合虚拟：主句按现在时间用 would not be，不能用 would not have been。

stem: If I ______ (be) you, I would take the job without hesitation.
explanation: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句中，be 动词一律用 were，主语是 I 也不能用 was，所以填 were。

stem: “If he had left earlier, he would catch the train.” 这句话的虚拟语气形式完全正确。
explanation: 从句 had left 表示与过去事实相反，主句也应用 would have done，应为 would have caught the train；would catch 是现在或将来的形式，前后时间不一致。
